alt.field: Stored real electric field across a two-dimensional periodic photonic grating at 1550 nm. Blue and red encode signed Re(Ey) relative to unit incident amplitude; outlined rectangles show the saved dielectric geometry. Both spatial axes use micrometres at equal scale.
alt.spectrum: Twenty-one stored target-order efficiency samples from 1300 to 1700 nanometres. Open circles show the actual solves; straight segments connect them. The vertical axis is incident-power percentage from zero to one hundred.

captions.short_field: Stored M9 simulation at 1550 nm · Re(Ey) relative to unit incident amplitude · 2D model, not measured intensity.
captions.short_spectrum: 21 stored wavelength solves · target order +1 · percent of incident power. Straight segments connect samples; no intermediate solve.
captions.combined: Exact retained PhotonSmith data: all 97 × 96 signed real-field samples at 1550 nm, with the saved grating geometry and equal spatial scale, plus all 21 sampled target-order efficiencies. This is a legacy M9 two-dimensional numerical model, not device data. Search used M5. The field is Re(Ey) relative to unit incident amplitude, not intensity.
captions.detail: Wavelength is multiplied by 1000 from micrometres to nanometres, and efficiency by 100 from an incident-power fraction to percent. The spectrum samples are 1300–1700 nm in 20 nm steps; the separate 1550 nm design solve (93.58787717897128%) is not one of those 21 samples and is not inserted or fitted into the curve. The stored spectrum maximum is 93.18919426520034% at 1540 nm.

integration.field: Use field-desktop.svg or field-mobile.svg at <=640px, preserving aspect ratio; matching PNGs are substantially smaller web fallbacks.
integration.spectrum: Use spectrum-desktop.svg or spectrum-mobile.svg at <=640px, preserving aspect ratio.
integration.phone: Mobile files are designed at 320 CSS pixels; the review390 PNGs are direct numeric rerasterizations of the same composition at 390 pixels.
integration.font: IBM Plex Sans glyph outlines, no external font runtime.
